GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&amp;nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI&quot;&gt;Co-create the future with us&lt;\/a&gt; as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;*&lt;em&gt;Fortune 500\u00ae is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer to lead technical direction across GitLab&#39;s Core DevOps services, the systems the majority of our users touch every day. Distinguished Engineers are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the most senior level of technical leadership within and across divisions at the company.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Core DevOps builds continuous Integration, continuous deployment, planning, and source control experiences. These are among the most mature, highest traffic, and most deeply interconnected systems at GitLab. They carry years of accumulated architectural decisions, they sit in the critical path of our customers&#39; own delivery pipelines, and they are being reshaped by the shift toward AI native development. The job is to raise their quality, converge them onto a coherent go-forward architecture, and retire accumulated risk, all without interrupting the millions of users and Fortune 100 organizations who depend on them.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;GitLab is pursuing a set of company-wide engineering goals: large gains in developer productivity, measurably higher quality in what we ship, and engineering practices reshaped around AI and agentic workflows. Core DevOps is where much of that strategy has to land, because these are the services our own engineers and our customers depend on daily. In this role you will bring that strategy into Core DevOps in a form that works for long lived production systems, and carry what you learn here back out to the rest of engineering.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set and continuously refine the go forward technical direction for CI, CD, Plan, and source code experiences, aligned against the horizontal architectural initiatives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work directly with the VP of Engineering as her technical counterpart on planning, technical investment, and where the group&#39;s engineering effort should go.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Translate GitLab&#39;s company-wide productivity, quality, and AI native engineering goals into concrete technical direction for Core DevOps, and turn into iterable roadmaps, partnering broadly across the org.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define what good means in measurable terms for these services, including availability, latency at p95 and p99, pipeline success rate, test reliability, data correctness, and defect escape rate, then hold designs and implementations to it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain a clear and current picture of systemic technical risk across the group, including single points of failure, unowned critical paths, brittle coupling between CI\/CD and Plan, scaling limits, and past decisions that now constrain the roadmap. Drive a prioritized plan to retire it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead the hardest design decisions hands on, writing code, prototypes, and proofs of concept where a design argument needs evidence behind it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive convergence on shared patterns, libraries, and paved paths, reducing how many different ways the same problem gets solved across the group.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design migration paths that let large, long lived systems change underneath users without breaking them, using incremental cutover, dual run, measurable rollback, and deprecation with clear timelines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Adopt the platform capabilities coming from GitLab&#39;s AI organization and the company&#39;s productivity initiatives into Core DevOps, feed this group&#39;s requirements back into them, and help prove what works on systems of this scale and maturity.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the escalation point for complex or contested technical decisions across the group, including those where no single team owns the outcome.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Review significant designs and merge requests in the group&#39;s critical paths, and use review to teach rather than only to gate.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure designs hold across GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, and respect multi-tenant, compliance, and data governance boundaries in each.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and SRE so Core DevOps services are observable and debuggable, and so failure modes degrade gracefully instead of cascading.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Make architectural constraints and opportunities clear to Product in roadmap terms, so that technical investment and product ambition get planned together instead of traded off late.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let teams across the group make aligned decisions independently.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Grow Principal and Staff Engineers across Core DevOps, raise the bar on design rigor and technical writing, and contribute to the technical hiring bar for senior individual contributors.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com, and complete Interview Training to participate in hiring as a technical interviewer or panel member.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a Staff, Principal, or equivalent senior technical leadership role.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep expertise in AI and ML systems, including large language models, agentic frameworks, and autonomous workflow design at production scale.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven track record of leading hands-on technical experimentation, including defining evaluation frameworks, running benchmarks, and translating findings into scalable architecture decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong background in scalable, multi-tenant distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience designing and implementing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for production systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams or divisions without direct authority.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization with excellent written and asynchronous communication skills.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-pay-transparency&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;pay-input&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;description&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;The base salary range for this role\u2019s listed level is currently for residents of the&amp;nbsp;United States only. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases \u2014 from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering \u2014 channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA\/SE organisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader \u2014 conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We&#39;re Looking For&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails\/safety.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch\/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with the Databricks platform \u2014 or the ability to ramp on it quickly \u2014 including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of technical leadership and mentorship \u2014 someone who elevates the people around them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data\/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Nice to Have&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML\/GenAI space.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare\/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why This Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have \u2014 companies building the future in real time \u2014 with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You&#39;ll shape how one of EMEA&#39;s highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About Databricks&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide \u2014 including adidas, AT&amp;amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 \u2014 rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. We also\u202fLead Optimistically,\u202ffirmly believing\u202fin and\u202fChampioning Growth and Development\u202ffor every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to\u202fleverage\u202fthe extensive global WPP Media &amp;amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the\u202fcutting edge\u202fof marketing and advertising.\u202f&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u202fCreate an Open environment\u202fbuilt on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events\u202fshowcasing\u202fteam wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.\u202f&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide \u2013 including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more \u2013 with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you\u2019re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.<\/p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\">\u00a0<\/div><h2><strong>Attributes We Value<\/strong><\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you\u2019re motivated by our mission and <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" class=\"c-link c-link--underline\" href=\"https:\/\/www.airwallex.com\/us\/operating-principles\"><u>operating principles<\/u><\/a>. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You're humble and collaborative; turn zero\u2011to\u2011one ideas into real products, and you \u201cget stuff done\u201d end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you\u2019ll tackle complex, high\u2011visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let\u2019s build what\u2019s next.<\/p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\">\u00a0<\/div><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>About the team:<\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Risk Operations is a global 1LOD team responsible for the Acquiring, Issuing and Credit Risk domains. The team handles cases and investigations across product domains, working closely with 2LOD and Commercial teams to ensure that Airwallex operates within its risk appetite. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we\u2019re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you\u2019ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Working at Wolt isn\u2019t always easy, but it\u2019s definitely exciting. Here you\u2019ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You\u2019ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you\u2019re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Wolt\u2019s AdTech &amp;amp; Promotions team is building the systems that power how restaurants and brands grow on our platform. From campaign creation to optimization and forecasting, we develop tools that help advertisers make smarter decisions and drive measurable results. As we expand our offering, we are investing in new capabilities that combine real-time data, scalable systems, and intuitive user experiences to unlock the next phase of growth.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re looking for a &lt;strong&gt;Staff Engineer&lt;\/strong&gt; to join the Wolt AdTech &amp;amp; Promotions organization, who can drive technical direction across this space and help us build reliable, scalable systems that directly impact revenue and advertiser success.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What you\u2019ll be doing&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive the technical vision and architecture for Wolt\u2019s AdTech and Promotions platforms, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and high-performing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide technical leadership across multiple teams and projects, bringing architectural consistency to complex, large-scale systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work across the &lt;strong&gt;end-to-end domain&lt;\/strong&gt;, contributing to backend services, data pipelines, and advertiser-facing tools.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and evolve systems that support &lt;strong&gt;campaign execution, targeting, ranking, allocation, and reporting&lt;\/strong&gt; in real-time or near real-time environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with engineering, product, and data stakeholders to align priorities, improve campaign performance, and manage trade-offs in a revenue-driven environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead large cross-team projects, guiding them from concept to rollout across multiple regions and time zones.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure strong operational excellence, including observability, reliability, and incident readiness for revenue-critical systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Promote best engineering practices, mentor engineers across teams, and support their growth in scalability and system design.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical colleagues, ensuring clarity and alignment across functions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to the technical roadmaps of AdTech and Promotions platforms by collaborating with other senior engineers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This position is based in &lt;strong&gt;London&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Our humble expectations&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Technical Expertise&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven track record designing and scaling &lt;strong&gt;large distributed systems in production environments&lt;\/strong&gt;.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong understanding of system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working with &lt;strong&gt;data-intensive and real-time or near real-time systems&lt;\/strong&gt;.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with AdTech concepts such as &lt;strong&gt;targeting, ranking, attribution, or experimentation&lt;\/strong&gt; is a strong plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and languages; while many of our services are written in Kotlin and Go, we are looking for someone language-agnostic.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to dive quickly into new domains and navigate complex system interactions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with modern cloud-native tools and data systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Kafka, MongoDB).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Communication &amp;amp; Influence&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong communicator with the ability to influence, align, and build consensus across diverse teams and stakeholders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable working in a global environment across &lt;strong&gt;US and international teams&lt;\/strong&gt;.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Skilled at translating complex technical decisions into clear direction for technical and non-technical audiences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, helping raise the technical bar across teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strong sense of ownership combined with a collaborative mindset&lt;\/strong&gt;, able to work effectively across team boundaries to deliver shared outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Proactive in identifying opportunities and gaps across teams&lt;\/strong&gt;, and driving alignment to solve problems holistically rather than locally.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What we offer&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Wolt, this role provides a rare opportunity to work on &lt;strong&gt;challenging AdTech problems at scale&lt;\/strong&gt;, where technical decisions directly impact revenue and user experience.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our compensation follows a &lt;strong&gt;total compensation model&lt;\/strong&gt;, combining a competitive base salary with DoorDash RSUs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will play a key role in &lt;strong&gt;building and evolving the next generation of advertisement tools and platforms&lt;\/strong&gt;, shaping how advertisers create, manage, and optimize campaigns across Wolt. This is not just about maintaining systems, but about &lt;strong&gt;defining and scaling new capabilities in a fast-growing domain&lt;\/strong&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Staff Engineer, you will have &lt;strong&gt;end-to-end ownership and high autonomy&lt;\/strong&gt;, with the ability to influence architecture, product direction, and engineering practices across teams. Your work will have &lt;strong&gt;clear, measurable business impact&lt;\/strong&gt;, directly contributing to revenue growth and advertiser success.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll be part of a &lt;strong&gt;global company operating at scale&lt;\/strong&gt;, collaborating with teams across Europe and the US, and solving problems that span multiple markets, use cases, and customer segments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role also offers strong opportunities for &lt;strong&gt;career growth and scope expansion&lt;\/strong&gt;, whether through deep technical leadership, cross-domain influence, or progression toward more senior individual contributor roles.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Alongside the technical challenge, you\u2019ll work with talented engineers and leaders in a &lt;strong&gt;diverse and international environment&lt;\/strong&gt;, shaping both our systems and engineering culture while mentoring and learning from others.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;iframe src=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/embed\/Ncz4s_oBczc&quot; width=&quot;560&quot; height=&quot;314&quot;&gt;&lt;\/iframe&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span data-sheets-root=&quot;1&quot;&gt;Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-sheets-root=&quot;1&quot;&gt;We\u2019re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That\u2019s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. World&#39;s leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there&#39;s a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Team:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The UK Value Engineering team is responsible for our largest Fortune500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what\u2019s possible with Data and AI. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis data &amp;amp; AI platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers\u2019 technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a &lt;strong&gt;Senior&lt;\/strong&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Value Engineer&lt;\/strong&gt; you are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers by owning their end-to-end value journey. You are their trusted technology &amp;amp; business advisor, helping organisations achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers \u2013 landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers\u2019 objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, helping organisations understand where Celonis fits into their IT landscape and AI strategy, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements. Your skillset combines a strong understanding of technology at both strategic and practical levels with consulting skills around strategic thinking and program management.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The work you\u2019ll do:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Identify &amp;amp; Frame Value&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Discover and translate customers\u2019 strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Advise organisations on how Celonis\u2019 platform fits into their existing IT landscape and AI strategy&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Use hands-on tech skills (SQL\/Python) to build out (AI) prototypes to bring the Celonis platform to life for new audiences&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Realize Value&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Scale Value&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The qualifications you need:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Data, Analytics, Applications &amp;amp; IT: &lt;\/strong&gt;Good knowledge of Business Software \/ SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), Hands-on SQL and\/or Python skills,, experience in collaborating with IT teams, experience developing dashboards and automations in tools like PowerBI or RPA, knowledge of and experience with AI-powered solutions.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Live for Customer Value: &lt;\/strong&gt;Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT\/Management Consulting with a Business Software \/ SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining \/ Analytics \/ Intelligence) within an Enterprise.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Process Improvement &amp;amp; Value Realization: &lt;\/strong&gt;Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,&amp;nbsp; being a change agent and training users\/process owners to realize value&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Project Management: &lt;\/strong&gt;Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Executive Stakeholder Management: &lt;\/strong&gt;Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and sovereign appearance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Business Domain Expertise: &lt;\/strong&gt;Understanding of the Finance and\/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Industry Expertise: &lt;\/strong&gt;Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities&amp;nbsp; &lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Degree: &lt;\/strong&gt;Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics or a comparable technical degree&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(236, 240, 241);&quot;&gt;#LI-TM-1&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What Celonis can offer you:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul class=&quot;p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested&quot; data-stringify-type=&quot;unordered-list&quot; data-list-tree=&quot;true&quot; data-indent=&quot;0&quot; data-border=&quot;0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;Pioneer Innovation:&lt;\/span&gt; Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;Ownership from Day 1:&lt;\/span&gt; Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;Holistic Well-being:&lt;\/span&gt; We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;discussion-id-2f7cb4da-dab4-8068-a80f-001c50b2d808 suggestion-update notion-enable-hover&quot; data-token-index=&quot;0&quot;&gt;With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What this job can offer you&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role is a core technical and programme lead position within CX Operations, working alongside CX leadership and cross-functional partners to build the automation and AI capabilities that shape how the team operates at scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own delivery end to end. You will work closely with CX leadership as priorities are shaped, bringing technical and operational input to inform decisions, bring technical judgment and operational context to those conversations, and then lead the work from scoping through to production and iteration. You will bring technical judgment and operational context to scoping discussions, and work with significant autonomy within agreed priorities to see initiatives through from design to production, while working as part of a broader team, not in isolation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The combination this role asks for is not common: someone technically confident to build and ship, with the programme management skills to run complex cross-functional work, and the communication skills to make both sides legible to each other. If that combination describes you, this is a role where you will have real ownership, real impact, and real variety.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How this role contributes to the department&#39;s and company&#39;s goals&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As Remote grows and the complexity of its customer base increases, CX has to maintain quality and responsiveness without being overwhelmed by volume or operational fragmentation. Automation and AI are central to how we do that, not by replacing good judgment, but by removing friction, surfacing the right information at the right moment, and giving specialists the tools to focus on work that actually requires a human.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Beyond efficiency, this role is about empowering the CX team. The tooling and automation built here determine how well our specialists can do their jobs, how quickly customers get real resolution, and how effectively CX can absorb new products, new partners, and growing complexity. That impact is direct and measurable.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/signalvnoise.com\/posts\/1430-hire-managers-of-one&quot;&gt;manager of one&lt;\/a&gt;: you identify what needs doing, set your own direction, and deliver without needing to be chased. You default to action and close your own loops.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong programme management alongside your technical ability. You can scope a complex initiative, manage stakeholders across functions, communicate clearly to non-technical audiences, and see it through from start to done, not just the build, the whole thing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on experience building automation and integration systems in a CX, support, or operations context. You understand what a support workflow looks like from the inside: what slows agents down, what good resolution actually means, and what tooling helps versus what just looks good in a demo.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Technical confidence: you can build, read, and debug code; design and work with APIs, webhooks, and integration standards including MCP; and move fast using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as part of your standard workflow. You take ownership of complex technical systems end to end, from design through to production.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solid experience with low-code and no-code workflow platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool, Gumloop, or similar, to design and run cross-system automations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You know when automation is the right answer and when it is not. You evaluate the problem before reaching for a tool, and you are as comfortable making the case against automating something as you are building it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience deploying AI agents or AI-assisted workflows in a production environment, including designing for failure, building in human oversight, and maintaining auditability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The ability to translate between operational needs and technical constraints in both directions, clearly, without jargon, and with the right level of detail for whoever is in the room.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You document what you build. Not as an afterthought, as part of how you work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Writes and speaks fluent English.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working in a remote-first environment is a plus but not required.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Automation &amp;amp; AI Development&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to and lead delivery of CX automation and AI initiatives, from scoping and design through to production and ongoing iteration.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that improve specialist effectiveness, reduce manual handling, and increase consistency across CX operations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deploy AI capabilities responsibly: design for failure, ensure appropriate human oversight is built in, and maintain the logs and auditability expected in a customer-facing support environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Stay across developments in AI and automation tooling, surface well-reasoned recommendations for your manager and the CX leadership team to evaluate.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;CX Tooling &amp;amp; Systems&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the technical delivery of CX tooling: the integrations, applications, and automated workflows that connect the platforms CX teams depend on every day.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and maintain integrations across the CX technology stack, including Zendesk and its application framework, Remote&#39;s internal platform, REST APIs, webhooks, and emerging integration standards such as MCP, ensuring data flows correctly, triggers fire reliably, and tooling holds up under operational load.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;As Remote&#39;s customer and partner base grows, support the CX tooling requirements that come with it: new channels, new integrations, increasing complexity.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Programme Delivery &amp;amp; Documentation&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage complex, multi-phase delivery: own dependencies, communicate proactively, and bring initiatives across the line without needing to be chased.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Document everything you own. Accurate, accessible documentation is part of the definition of done, not something that happens later.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify technical debt, undocumented processes, and fragile points in the CX automation stack and address them systematically.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Data &amp;amp; Continuous Improvement&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Use operational data and CX performance metrics to inform priorities and validate what is working. Build visibility into the impact of automation for CX leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define success metrics for each initiative, track them, and use them to make decisions about what to iterate on and what to stop.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Cross-functional Partnership&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work closely with CX operations and front-line teams to understand workflow pain points, validate solutions before they ship, and support adoption after they do.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with engineering, product, and data teams across Remote to align on architecture and escalate when a problem needs more than automation to solve.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders at all levels: operational teams, CX leadership, and cross-functional partners.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Practicals&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll report to:&lt;\/strong&gt; Senior Manager, CX Business Operations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Team:&lt;\/strong&gt; Customer Experience&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location&lt;\/strong&gt;: For this position we welcome everyone to apply, but we will prioritize applications from the following locations as we encourage our teams to diversify; You\u2019ll combine your strategic ownership with hands-on execution shaping our global supply chain strategy ensuring, reliable, compliant and cost-effective product supply to patients through an outsourced partner network.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This includes managing relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging and logistics providers, distributors, serialisation partners and other critical external suppliers to ensure a resilient, compliant and responsive supply chain.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Reporting to the Chief Operations and Regulatory Officer, you will work closely with Executive Leadership and colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Commercial and Finance, as well as a diverse network of external partners. You will also lead and develop the Supply Chain function, creating the capability, relationships and ways of working needed to support continued growth.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a role for a commercially minded and collaborative supply chain leader who enjoys operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, solve complex supply challenges and drive continuous improvement, while helping build a supply chain capable of supporting the next stage of the company&#39;s growth.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Our Company&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that &lt;strong&gt;Every Single Patient Matters&lt;\/strong&gt;. This is at the heart of why we work. As we look to grow, we\u2019re now looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life-changing treatments need life-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our core focus areas include rare metabolic, oncology, immunological, and neurological genetic conditions, where we improve existing drugs, repurpose them for new uses, and bring generics back to market. Using cutting-edge drug delivery technologies, we enhance the efficiency of treatments, offering patients greater freedom and choice.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you want to know more about what we do then, why not check out our website below and look at some of our patient stories:&amp;nbsp;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cyclepharma.com\/patient-advocacy\/patient-stories\/&quot;&gt;Patient Stories - Cycle Pharma&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll be doing in this role:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Supply Chain Strategy, Planning and Operations&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned to commercial priorities, product launches, lifecycle management and the organisation\u2019s broader growth ambitions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide clear, evidence-based, risk-adjusted recommendations on supply priorities, inventory trade-offs, supplier performance and escalation requirements, enabling timely, transparent and commercially informed decision-making.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide strategic oversight of the end-to-end supply chain, including demand and supply planning, inventory management, manufacturing scheduling, distribution and product availability, ensuring a reliable and responsive supply network.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead the Sales &amp;amp; Operations Planning (S&amp;amp;OP) process, bringing together commercial forecasts, customer demand, inventory strategy and manufacturing capacity to create a clear, aligned view of supply and demand. Proactively identify, communicate and mitigate emerging risks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establish and optimise inventory policies and supply strategies that balance product availability, supply resilience, risk and working capital requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define and maintain meaningful supply chain KPIs and performance measures, using data and insight to identify opportunities, strengthen accountability and drive continuous improvement across the supply network.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support business development initiatives, new product introductions and other growth initiatives, assessing supply chain requirements and developing scalable, compliant and fit-for-purpose supply solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the annual Supply Chain budget, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise costs and deliver value while maintaining regulatory compliance, supply resilience and product availability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Supply Chain Governance and Operational Excellence&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead strategic relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging providers, logistics partners, distributors, serialization providers and other critical supply chain partners, ensuring clear accountability and delivery against agreed service, quality and business requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establish and maintain effective supplier governance, including structured performance reviews, service-level management, quality oversight, issue resolution and improvement plans, ensuring external partners consistently meet expectations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work closely with Quality Assurance and relevant functions to ensure the external supply network operates in accordance with applicable GxP, GDP, DSCSA and other regulatory requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead the resolution and escalation of complex supply, quality, compliance and operational issues, coordinating internal teams and external partners to minimise business impact and protect product availability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive the development of scalable supply chain processes, improving visibility, data quality, operational efficiency and ways of working as the organisation and product portfolio grow.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide governance and oversight of critical supply chain systems and data, including ERP, serialization, GS1 and inventory management platforms, ensuring robust master data, system integrity and reliable reporting.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establish a culture of accountability and continuous improvement across the external supply network, using supplier performance insights, operational data and emerging risks to identify and deliver sustainable improvements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;People Leadership&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead and develop the Supply Chain function, setting clear priorities, expectations and ways of working while creating a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build team capability and succession strength through coaching, mentoring and targeted development, ensuring the function has the skills, expertise and capacity to support the organisation\u2019s future growth.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop strong, collaborative relationships with senior stakeholders, providing clear supply chain insight and challenge to support informed business decisions and representing Supply Chain effectively across cross-functional leadership and governance forums.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The following skills and experience will be important in helping you to succeed &lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;in this role:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Degree (or equivalent experience) in Supply Chain Management, Business Operations, or Life Sciences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Significant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare supply chain experience, including leadership responsibility for outsourced manufacturing and distribution networks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams and build strong internal and external relationships.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management, contract manufacturing, logistics, supplier management, and supply chain compliance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Knowledge of GDP, DSCSA, serialisation, and global pharmaceutical supply chain regulations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience leading cross-functional projects, With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we\u2019re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;London, United Kingdom (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days\/week in-office once our London office opens)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build Pallet\u2019s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help transform one of the world\u2019s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the opportunity&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet\u2019s commercial presence across Europe.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How you will make an impact&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe\u2019s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet\u2019s AI agent capabilities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Document repeatable customer use cases and market experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Business-fluent Spanish: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Willingness to travel extensively across Modern software is complex and dependency-rich, making it increasingly difficult to pinpoint the risks that truly matter. Endor Labs solves this challenge by building a call graph of your entire software estate\u2014enabling teams to clearly identify, prioritize, and fix critical risks faster.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Trusted by companies that are one or one hundred years old, Endor Labs secures code whether it was written by humans or AI, and whether it&#39;s 40-year old C++ code or cutting edge Bazel Monorepos. Endor Labs was founded by serial entrepreneurs Varun Badhwar and Dimitri Stiliadis, and is backed by leading VC firms such as Dell Technology Capital, Lightspeed, and Sierra Ventures.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Sound interesting? Let\u2019s talk if you want to be part of the next big leap in security innovation!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How You\u2019ll Make an Impact&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re hiring Enterprise Account Executives to own the full sales cycle\u2014from discovery to close\u2014driving new business with enterprise customers who care deeply about developer productivity and application security.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a technically complex, multi-threaded sale. Our buyers are CISOs, AppSec leaders, and engineering executives, and you&#39;ll translate Endor Labs&#39; capabilities into clear business value while partnering with Solution Architects, CS, SDRs, and Marketing. You will&amp;nbsp;be&amp;nbsp;working&amp;nbsp;as part of a global social media team for a leading technology company,&amp;nbsp;as well as supporting&amp;nbsp;other key accounts,&amp;nbsp;creating social-first content for&amp;nbsp;Instagram, TikTok,&amp;nbsp;LinkedIn,&amp;nbsp;Facebook&amp;nbsp;and&amp;nbsp;X.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will&amp;nbsp;be responsible for&amp;nbsp;developing social&amp;nbsp;strategies that&lt;u&gt;:&lt;\/u&gt;&amp;nbsp;connect audience&amp;nbsp;behaviour&amp;nbsp;with brand&amp;nbsp;objectives.&amp;nbsp;You will partner&amp;nbsp;closely&amp;nbsp;with&amp;nbsp;creative&amp;nbsp;teams, account leaders, and clients to guide the direction of&amp;nbsp;campaigns&amp;nbsp;across platforms.&amp;nbsp;Your work will influence&amp;nbsp;content planning, creative development,&amp;nbsp;community engagement, and measurement approaches.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for someone who&amp;nbsp;is passionate &amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;about&amp;nbsp;social platforms,&amp;nbsp;embraces&amp;nbsp;new&amp;nbsp;content&amp;nbsp;formats&lt;u&gt; &lt;\/u&gt;and with strong client management skills and the flexibility to work across different types of social platforms.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You\u2019ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and implement robust, data-driven social media&amp;nbsp;and digital engagement&amp;nbsp;strategies by conducting in-depth&amp;nbsp;reputational&amp;nbsp;analysis, trend forecasting, and&amp;nbsp;stakeholder&amp;nbsp;\/ audience&amp;nbsp;mapping, ensuring these strategies are not only clear and compelling but also directly aligned with overarching business&amp;nbsp;objectives&amp;nbsp;and measurable KPIs.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead&amp;nbsp;and optimise strategic social platform planning for both large-scale, time-bound campaigns and continuous &#39;always-on&#39; engagement initiatives, meticulously defining channel-specific content ecosystems, targeting parameters, and maximising reach and impact across the relevant digital landscape.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Translate performance data, intelligence, and&amp;nbsp;stakeholder&amp;nbsp;sentiment into actionable strategic recommendations that directly inspire and inform innovative creative development, campaign optimisation, and future content planning.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Persuasively present complex strategic frameworks, insights, and actionable plans to both internal stakeholders and external clients, instilling confidence and securing buy-in through clear, compelling communication and a proven executive presence.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;At the client level:&amp;nbsp;Leverage&amp;nbsp;our suite of tools to&amp;nbsp;anticipate&amp;nbsp;threats&amp;nbsp;and inform innovative strategic pivots&amp;nbsp;for our clients&amp;nbsp;that&amp;nbsp;build&amp;nbsp;reputation, strategic&amp;nbsp;relevance&amp;nbsp;and competitive advantage.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;At the practice level:&amp;nbsp;Proactively&amp;nbsp;monitor&amp;nbsp;and interpret evolving social media trends, platform evolutions, and shifts in audience behaviour to&amp;nbsp;identify&amp;nbsp;emerging opportunities&amp;nbsp;for our clients, teams and to keep Burson ahead of the curve.&amp;nbsp;You will join a&amp;nbsp;vibrant&amp;nbsp;community of Social&amp;nbsp;&amp;amp; Content&amp;nbsp;contributors across our London office, working together to grow and innovate the offer.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Experience that contributes to success &lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Embed&amp;nbsp;seamlessly into our Corporate and Public Affairs&amp;nbsp;team, working across our specialisms to understand our clients and the&amp;nbsp;factors shaping reputation across&amp;nbsp;stakeholders,&amp;nbsp;media,&amp;nbsp;policy, regulation, issues and more.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate&amp;nbsp;with creative teams, guiding the development of concepts and content designed to authentically connect with and deeply resonate&amp;nbsp;with target stakeholders,&lt;u&gt; &lt;\/u&gt;ensuring messaging is&amp;nbsp;reputationally&amp;nbsp;relevant and highly engaging.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Creating&amp;nbsp;effective&amp;nbsp;content briefs&amp;nbsp;for&amp;nbsp;our design team,&amp;nbsp;developing copy and making recommendations on assets&amp;nbsp;and overseeing digital editorial calendars.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proactively&amp;nbsp;monitor&amp;nbsp;and interpret evolving social media trends, platform evolutions, and shifts in audience behaviour to&amp;nbsp;identify&amp;nbsp;emerging opportunities,&amp;nbsp;anticipate&amp;nbsp;competitive&amp;nbsp;threats, and inform innovative strategic pivots that&amp;nbsp;maintain&amp;nbsp;brand&amp;nbsp;relevance and competitive advantage.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Articulate and persuasively present complex strategic frameworks, insights, and actionable plans to both internal stakeholders and external clients, instilling confidence and securing buy-in through clear, compelling communication and a proven executive presence.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Creating content briefs to feed into our design and editing team, developing&amp;nbsp;copy&amp;nbsp;and making recommendations on assets and content structure&amp;nbsp;and overseeing the management&amp;nbsp;social calendar across multiple regions for a global LinkedIn company page&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Managing client communications including leading content development workstreams, updating WIPs and calendars, internal communication with colleagues&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You belong at Burson:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our vision is for Burson to be the leading \u2018academy company\u2019 for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today\u2019s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Burson, we\u2019re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That\u2019s why it\u2019s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can\u2019t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view\u2014your talent\u2014is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it\u2019s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We believe the best work happens when we&#39;re together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. For more information, visit &lt;a href=&quot;WPP.com&quot;&gt;WPP.com&lt;\/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;For more information visit&amp;nbsp;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.bursonglobal.com\/&quot;&gt;bursonglobal.com&lt;\/a&gt; and follow us on &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/company\/burson\/posts\/?feedView=all&quot;&gt;LinkedIn&lt;\/a&gt; and&amp;nbsp;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.instagram.com\/burson.global\/?hl=en&quot;&gt;Instagram&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;More about the role:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Burson\u2019s Intelligence &amp;amp; Insights capability builds the data infrastructure, pipelines and AI-enabled workflows that power communications measurement and impact reporting at scale. Reporting directly to JT Joseph within the Intelligence &amp;amp; Insights practice and based in London, UK (Hybrid working policy), this role is central to leading the technical development of Fount, Burson\u2019s flagship communications intelligence platform.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In this role, you will be responsible for translating product vision and technical specifications into robust, scalable data engineering and business intelligence solutions. Working closely with product leadership, you will contribute technical insights and architectural recommendations that help shape the platform&#39;s future evolution. You will operate within a structured Agile team managed in Jira, where product vision, priorities and roadmaps are set by Product Owners, while your core focus is executing this vision to the highest engineering standards.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will serve as the lead engineer responsible for building, maintaining and enhancing Fount, Burson\u2019s custom data pipeline and database layer for communications reporting. Fount enables analysts to configure client monitoring subscriptions, Boolean searches, data ingestion and AI enrichment through an analyst-facing configuration layer. Under the direction of product leadership, you will execute technical deliverables that make the platform more reliable, scalable and seamless for non-technical users to configure and operate.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a senior individual-contributor role with technical leadership and mentoring responsibility, rather than a formal people-management position. You will directly mentor a junior engineer while providing technical peer support and alignment across the wider engineering team. The position combines strategic engineering with hands-on delivery across major pillars:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Technical Leadership &amp;amp; Architecture&lt;\/strong&gt; (e.g., pipeline design, engineering standards, technical reviews, technical debt refactoring, mentoring)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Fount Platform &amp;amp; Data Engineering&lt;\/strong&gt; (e.g., ETL\/ELT pipelines, Python services, SQL layers, API integrations, cloud infrastructure, cost &amp;amp; performance optimization)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Analyst Enablement &amp;amp; AI Integrations&lt;\/strong&gt; (e.g., NocoDB configuration, Boolean ingestion, LLM enrichment frameworks, MCP &amp;amp; provider-hosted integrations)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll do:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead the technical design, architectural standards, and delivery of business-critical data pipelines, services, and platform components across media monitoring and communications data sources.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner closely with Product Owners in an Agile Jira environment to assess technical feasibility, evaluate trade-offs, and translate product requirements into maintainable, scalable technical solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and maintain production-ready Python services, SQL transformation layers, star-schema data models, and API integrations across relational databases and cloud storage (Azure Data Lake).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Optimise pipeline performance, system reliability, compute efficiency, and AI token costs, while establishing robust monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident-response practices.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Enhance Fount\u2019s analyst-facing configuration layer (Boolean searches, API ingestion rules, NocoDB workflows) to streamline analyst setup and reduce routine engineering intervention.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Operationalise AI-enabled enrichment frameworks (classification, summarisation, sentiment, topic detection, LLMs, MCP-enabled integrations) with strict quality assurance, governance, and cost controls.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deliver custom data engineering solutions for specialized client requirements, integrating internal, API-driven, and third-party research datasets into scalable reporting workflows.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, architectural guidance, and knowledge-sharing, while systematically refactoring technical debt and maintaining operational runbooks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Experience that contributes to success:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Substantial experience designing, building, and operating production data platforms, star-schema data models, and complex ELT\/ETL pipelines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, including clean object-oriented design, Pandas, query optimization, and REST API integrations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on experience within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, ADLS), Azure DevOps, Git, CI\/CD pipelines, and automated testing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven track record in system reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, logging\/monitoring, and performance optimization.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated capability mentoring junior engineers and elevating team capabilities through code reviews, technical standards, and documentation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Agile execution expertise using Jira, partnering closely with Product Owners to evaluate technical trade-offs and manage competing roadmap priorities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with modern AI &amp;amp; integration frameworks, including LLM enrichment workflows, semi-structured formats (e.g., Parquet), NoSQL, and provider-hosted or MCP-enabled integrations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Exposure to complementary technologies, such as low-code UI tools (NocoDB\/Airtable), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform\/Terragrunt), Power BI\/DAX, or communications measurement data.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;#LI-SF2&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div You will bring an understanding of the communications, media intelligence, social intelligence, measurement and research landscape, enabling you to partner effectively with practitioners and translate business needs into operational action.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role will report into Fred Macleod, Intelligence and Insights MD, UK&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll do:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Support the Growth of the Intelligence Business&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide visibility of Intelligence pipeline, revenue performance and growth opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help identify opportunities to expand Intelligence services across existing and prospective clients.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with Intelligence leadership to track business performance against growth objectives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain oversight of resource demand, utilisation and capacity across the Intelligence team. business priorities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Operationalise the delivery of intelligence product offerings enhancing delivery and growth opportunities&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify delivery risks,
