Burson"],"job_types":[],"location":"London","created_at":1790513704},{"slug":"graduate-scale-space-london-235005","company_name":"Blenheimchalcot","title":"Graduate - Scale Space","description":"&lt;h1&gt;Graduate Programme \u2014 Scale Space&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;ul data-spread=&quot;false&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a growing business operates, while being supported to take ownership of work that matters?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Scale Space&lt;\/strong&gt;, one of the businesses within the Blenheim Chalcot portfolio.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;ABOUT US&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital, including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets. Ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees supporting their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than \u00a31.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over \u00a3500 million.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;We work closely with investment and strategic partners including PayPal, FIS, L&amp;amp;G, Tencent, Experian, Google, Worldpay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to best-practice tools, solutions and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new businesses get off the ground, including technology, growth, talent, finance, legal and tax.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and OnSide Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;ABOUT SCALE SPACE&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;Scale Space is a community and workspace designed to bring together ambitious businesses, entrepreneurs, scale-ups and innovators.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;Based in White City, Scale Space provides more than just flexible workspace. It creates an environment where growing businesses can connect, collaborate and access the networks, expertise and opportunities they need to scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;The team works across community, events, partnerships, operations and customer experience to ensure that members receive a high-quality experience while helping to build a connected and ambitious business community.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Scale Space&lt;\/strong&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;You will be embedded within the Scale Space team and contribute to meaningful projects across the business, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot&#39;s learning, development and employee benefits.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul data-spread=&quot;true&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Dedicated to Scale Space&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Scale Space. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Scale Space and its growth, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-moving and entrepreneurial business.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Training &amp;amp; Development&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Scale Space. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Scale Space team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Early Careers Development&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your substantive role remains fully dedicated to Scale Space.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Graduate Community&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Scale Space.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Accountability&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Scale Space and see the direct impact of your work on the business, its members and the wider community.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;ARE YOU BC?&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech-related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline. Different areas of expertise bring valuable new perspectives.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul data-spread=&quot;true&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Curious&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 people in BC are inquisitive. They want to understand \u2018why\u2019 and consider whether there is a better approach rather than simply accepting \u2018it\u2019s how we\u2019ve always done it\u2019. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;\u2018Doers\u2019&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 we are a community of proactive self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, but we look for people who can use their initiative, take ownership and drive work forward on a daily basis.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Flexible Mindset&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility in order to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Enthusiasm&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 you do not need to be a \u2018techy\u2019 at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about innovation, growth and the changing nature of industries, with a desire to work in an environment where new and challenging things happen every day.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Humble &amp;amp; Sociable&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;\u2013 building and scaling businesses is never easy. As such, we have a \u2018no-ego\u2019 policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team rather than drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul data-spread=&quot;false&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be part of the UK\u2019s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to learn from the incredible talent across BC.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be exposed to the right mix of challenge, responsibility and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Scale Space.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A fun and open, if a little cricket-obsessed, atmosphere.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Discretionary bonus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;25 days of paid holiday plus your birthday off.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Life Assurance, Pension Scheme and Cycle to Work Scheme.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental cover and gym subsidies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;APPLICATION &amp;amp; PROCESS&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;We have a three-stage process:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stage 1:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;Telephone interview with a member of the BC Talent Team.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stage 2:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;Virtual assessment day, consisting of both individual and group activities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stage 3:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;Final interviews with Blenheim Chalcot and Scale Space at Scale Space, White City.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;isSelectedEnd&quot;&gt;&lt;em&gt;Please note that the timeframes provided above are subject to change. Babyzone","description":"&lt;p&gt;Graduate Programme \u2014 Babyzone&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life?&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a tech company is built, and be supported while taking ownership of work that matters?&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to Babyzone, one of the social-impact organisations supported by BC.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;ABOUT US&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets - ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees to support their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than \u00a31.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over \u00a3500 million.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&amp;amp;G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, finance, legal and tax.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust,&amp;nbsp;Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ABOUT BABYZONE&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Babyzone is&amp;nbsp;an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will be embedded within the Babyzone team and contribute to meaningful projects that support the charity&#39;s growth, operations and impact, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot&#39;s learning, development and employee benefits.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Dedicated to Babyzone \u2013 although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Babyzone. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Babyzone and its mission, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-growing, mission-led organisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Training &amp;amp; Development \u2013 we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Babyzone team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Early Careers Development \u2013 as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your role itself remains fully dedicated to Babyzone.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Graduate Community \u2013 you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Babyzone.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Accountability \u2013 you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Babyzone, seeing the direct impact of your work on the organisation and the families and communities it serves.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;ARE YOU BC?&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline \u2013 different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Curious&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;\u2013 people in BC are inquisitive, they want to understand \u2018why\u2019 and consider if there is a better approach rather than take on the \u2018it\u2019s how we\u2019ve always done it\u2019 perspective. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;\u2018Doers\u2019&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;\u2013 surprisingly, this is not a given in a lot of working environments; we are a community of pro-active self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, though we do look for proactive people who can use their initiative and drive on a daily basis. Working in an environment where everyone has this trait is incredibly refreshing and we strive to maintain it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Flexible Mindset \u2013&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital for us.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Enthusiasm \u2013&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;you do not need to be a \u2018techy\u2019 at heart to work in our environment. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about what digitalisation is doing to industries and a drive to work in a pioneering sector which represents that drive. A desire for doing new and challenging things makes coming into work a whole lot more fun.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Humble &amp;amp; Sociable&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;\u2013 building a tech start-up is never easy. As such, we have a \u2018no-ego\u2019 policy and seek out people who bring energy to a team, not drain it. We have a down-to-earth and personable culture; we solve complex problems but do not take ourselves too seriously and look to have fun whilst doing so.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you see yourself in this and would like to work with similarly minded people, we would love to hear from you!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU AS A BC EMPLOYEE:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be part of the UK\u2019s leading digital venture builder and have the opportunity to be a part of and learn from the incredible talent in BC&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be exposed to the right mix of challenges and learning and development opportunities while building deep, hands-on experience within Babyzone&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A fun and open, if a little cricket obsessed, atmosphere&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Discretionary bonus&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;25 days of paid holidays + your birthday off&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Life Assurance, Pension Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible Benefits including Private Medical and Dental, Gym Subsidiaries&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;APPLICATION &amp;amp; PROCESS&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you are keen to apply, please submit your CV and a member of our Talent Team will contact you with next steps. We have a rigorous recruitment process, which we use for all our roles to ensure we attract the very best talent.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We have a three-stage process that will consist of the following:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Stage 1: Telephone interview with a member of the BC Talent team&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stage 2:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;Virtual assessment day, consisting of both individual and group activities&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Stage 3: Final interviews with Blenheim Chalcot and Babyzone at Scale Space, White City&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;*Please note the timeframes provided above are subject to change, which we will communicate throughout the process*&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Blenheim Chalcot is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values, thus making it core to our business. We strive to maximise the diversity of our workforce and welcome applications from everyone. We encourage diversity through perspective, background, identity, and thought whilst also fostering an environment where everyone can express themselves regardless of your race, religion, sex, gender, colour, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We are committed to continuing to nurture an inclusive environment and building a diverse workforce.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role.&amp;nbsp; This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for.&amp;nbsp; You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing&amp;nbsp;&lt;a ---------- but please note that this means we will no longer consider you for the role you have applied for.&amp;nbsp;You can review our privacy policy&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.blenheimchalcot.com\/recruitment-privacy-policy\/&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;here&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;<p>Find <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.co.uk\">Jobs in United Kingdom<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.co.uk\/jobs\/companies\/blenheimchalcot\/graduate-babyzone-london-73569","tags":["Graduates & Interns"],"job_types":[],"location":"London","created_at":1790513704},{"slug":"remote-senior-channel-account-manager-bilingual-german-uk-422494","company_name":"Keepersecurity","title":"Senior Channel Account Manager, Bilingual (German) - UK","description":"&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Description&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Keeper is hiring a driven, German speaking Senior Channel Account Manager to join the Keeper EMEA Channel Sales team. Qualified candidates must permanently reside in the UK (London). This is a fully remote position for those residing in London.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Keeper&#39;s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organisations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for building pipeline and channel revenue with high performance partners.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About Keeper&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of public sector IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM\u00ae, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner\u00ae Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why agencies trust Keeper to defend against today\u2019s sophisticated adversaries at &lt;a href=&quot;http:\/\/keepersecurity.com&quot;&gt;KeeperSecurity.com&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The German speaking Senior Channel Account Manager will report to our Director of Channel, EMEA carrying a primary focus on building pipeline and channel revenue with existing channel partners. There will also be a heavy focus sourcing strategic new channel relationships. This position requires the candidate to be extremely motivated, results-driven and have a good network within the channel ecosystem.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Responsible for the day-to-day recruitment and relationship management of channel partners to include value added resellers, distributors, systems integrators and strategic software partners (primarily in Germany)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as a liaison between Keeper and assigned channel partners&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Communicate with English and German speaking clients, both verbal and written&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build, maintain, and manage relationships with current and prospective channel partners&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establish productive, professional relationships with key sales and channel personnel in assigned partner accounts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coordinate the involvement of Keeper personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet partner performance objectives and partners\u2019 expectations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Sell through partner organizations to end users in coordination with partner sales resources&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Meet assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned partner accounts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage direct\/channel conflict by fostering excellent communication between the channel and direct sales teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure partner compliance with Channel Partner programs and agreements&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participate in a partner planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones associated with a productive partner relationship&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify partner GTM &amp;amp;\/or services offerings; working with partner sales resources, marketing, etc. develop &amp;amp; launch offerings to point of incremental joint revenue achievement&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build relationships with technology vendors to identify mutual greenfield opportunities with shared partners&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain channel opportunity registrations in Salesforce.com and assist the direct sales team in closing channel generated leads&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Plan and execute on Channel Marketing activities and events to support brand awareness and demand generation with the Strategic Partner group&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to travel to and from customer meetings (locally and nationally) &amp;amp; rent and\/or operate a vehicle on behalf of the company&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;5+ years of security SaaS channel sales experience&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Must be bilingual, native German with English fluency (both verbal and written)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven success driving revenue growth via channel partners&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Good understanding of Partner Incentive programs and PRM tools&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong interpersonal skills and ability to excel in a team oriented atmosphere&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong written\/verbal communications skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Extremely motivated and goal-oriented&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Must want a career-oriented environment that is both fun and professional&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You share our values, and work in accordance with those values&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Willingness to travel up to 50%&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Benefits&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Onsite lunches&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Private healthcare (no wait period)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Pension contribution (no wait period)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Sick Pay&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bike-to-Work Scheme (if local)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Keeper is an equal opportunity employer. team: We are looking for a Solutions Engineer to join our team in Paris!&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Solutions Engineer will report directly to the EMEA Solution Engineer Manager, and will play a pivotal role in helping prospects understand the value of DataDome for their business. This position is not just about technical expertise\u2014it\u2019s about becoming a trusted partner to clients, guiding them from introductory and demo discussions, through to production implementation. As a Solutions Engineer, you will collaborate closely with AEs\/AMs and clients to solve complex challenges, understand pain points and establish success criteria in order to deliver tailored solutions that drive real-world impact.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is more than a technical role\u2014it\u2019s an opportunity to sit alongside clients as a strategic partner, contributing energy, ideas, and expertise to solve the hardest problems in our industry. Every day will bring new challenges and opportunities to expand your technical expertise, advocate for clients, and make a lasting impact.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You will be more specifically in charge of\u2026&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Understanding complex customer business problems and advise them on how to deploy the DataDome solution&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Visualizing customer internal systems and information topology&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Leading technical discussion with prospects in defining challenges and identifying client success criteria&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Preparing and delivering high impact presentations and demos that tell DataDome&#39;s differentiated story&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Guiding customers through the evaluation process ensuring that DataDome&#39;s solution meets key business objectives and technical requirements&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Configuring prospect&#39;s instance to enhance bot detection&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working cross-functionally between different sales, engineering, product and marketing teams to promote the adoption of the DataDome solution and share customer feedback&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborating with the Account Executive team to assess, qualify and track customer opportunities in SalesForce, and contribute to the design of effective technical solutions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;It would be great if you have:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor\u2019s Degree in Computer Science\/Engineering or equivalent experience&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;At least &lt;strong&gt;5 years pre-sales experience within an enterprise level SaaS ecosystem. Cybersecurity experience is not necessary, but appreciated.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A consultative approach with solving the customer\u2019s business challenges and have a track record of successfully overcoming technical and security objections and highlighting product value as a whole&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in translating technical concepts into language for varied audiences&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Good understanding of web-based solutions, website development and structured data&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Highly analytical mindset, that can manage client relationships as part of a market leading, AI driven organization.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Customer oriented with excellent written and verbal communication skills, as well project management experience&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bonus&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are interested in deep diving into data and you are familiar with Kibana\/Elasticsearch&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have experience with Apache, Nginx, Varnish, IIS, lambda@edge&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What\u2019s in it for you?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;discussion-id-31f95671-66d2-8029-bd3e-001c551b69bb notion-enable-hover&quot; data-token-index=&quot;0&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Flex Life&lt;\/strong&gt;:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;discussion-id-31f95671-66d2-8029-bd3e-001c551b69bb notion-enable-hover&quot; data-token-index=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;font-semibold text-foreground&quot;&gt;While we offer hybrid options, this position requires 3 days per week in our Paris office, located next to the Opera Garnier. You will also receive a 500\u20ac stipend to help you set up your ideal workspace&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Generous Health Benefits:&lt;\/strong&gt; &amp;nbsp;Employees are covered by statutory health insurance (or private insurance if eligible), with contributions shared between employee and employer.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Social Security:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;Full coverage under the German social security system, including statutory pension insurance, unemployment insurance, and long-term care insurance, with contributions shared between employee and employer.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Work Accident Insurance :&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;Full coverage for work-related accidents and occupational diseases, 100% covered by the employer.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Professional Development:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;#Growth is part of our DNA, therefore we provide an annual stipend to invest in yourself.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Events &amp;amp; Teambuilding:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;Feel the #TeamSpirit both virtually &amp;amp; onsite, with several events &amp;amp; workshops planned throughout the year, including two annual offsite events, summer &amp;amp; winter parties, lunch &amp;amp; learns, &amp;amp; much more.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Parent Care:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;Gift &amp;amp; care packages for parents. Employees also benefit from mandatory parental leave and job protection in line with local regulations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;PTO :&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;Includes a minimum of 20 paid vacation days per year (based on a 5-day work week), plus public holidays.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What are the next steps?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;If your application is selected, our Talent Acquisition Manager will contact you for a first chat&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will then meet with Ahmed our Solution Engineer Manager&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will do a 1h work session on typical client situations with our Head of sales and our SE team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will meet Chris our Chief Revenue Officer based in the US&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The final step will be a meeting with Benjamin our CEO&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Welcome to DataDome!&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About DataDome:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;DataDome delivers real-time bot and agent trust management, giving businesses complete visibility and control over all traffic\u2014human, bot, or AI. Named a Leader in The Forrester Wave\u2122 for Bot Management, DataDome is trusted by enterprises like Etsy, PayPal, and Soundcloud. Acting as a traffic control plane, DataDome&#39;s multi-layered AI engine leverages thousands of models and 5 trillion signals daily to analyze intent and stop fraud in under 2 milliseconds\u2014letting legitimate users through seamlessly across websites, apps, APIs, and MCPs. This role is responsible for building and maintaining a scalable, audit-ready accounting organization that can support a fast-growing SaaS business and increasingly complex reporting and statutory requirements.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;You will manage and develop a small &amp;amp; talented team, coordinate with external accounting partners where relevant, and act as the senior accounting leader for cross-functional stakeholders globally. You will partner closely with Finance leadership to set accounting policies, strengthen internal controls, anticipate risk, and support strategic initiatives (new entities, process\/tooling evolution, potential M&amp;amp;A integration).&lt;br&gt;This is a high-ownership role requiring strong technical judgment, operational excellence, and the ability to communicate clearly in English with international stakeholders and auditors.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;****\ud83d\udc49 &lt;strong&gt;Your scope:&amp;nbsp; As the&lt;\/strong&gt; Global Accoutant Director &lt;strong&gt;:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Global Accounting Leadership &amp;amp; Close Governance&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will set the operating rhythm and standards for global accounting, ensuring consistent execution across EMEA, US, and Singapore. You will own the month-end and year-end close governance, including close timelines, review standards, quality controls, and escalation management. You will ensure balance sheet integrity through robust reconciliations and review, and you will drive continuous improvements to shorten close timelines and increase reliability.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Accounting Policy, Technical Accounting &amp;amp; Judgment&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own and document key accounting positions and policies relevant to a global SaaS group (e.g., revenue recognition, contract modifications, commissions\/cost capitalization, FX, leases, share-based payments, intercompany). You will ensure appropriate application of local statutory requirements while maintaining consistent group reporting and management reporting principles. You will proactively assess the impact of evolving standards and business changes and translate them into operational accounting practices.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Audit Ownership &amp;amp; External Stakeholder Management&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be the primary point of contact for external auditors and advisors, owning audit planning, coordination, and delivery. You will ensure audit readiness year-round through strong documentation, control evidence, and a disciplined PBC process. You will manage relationships with local advisors (tax, payroll, corporate secretarial) across jurisdictions as needed.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Revenue, Order-to-Cash &amp;amp; Finance Operations Partnership&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will provide oversight of revenue accounting for subscription-based offerings, including billing flows, revenue recognition, deferred revenue, and cut-off. You will partner with Sales Ops\/RevOps, Legal, and FP&amp;amp;A to ensure contracting and pricing structures support clean accounting outcomes. You will guide improvements to order-to-cash controls (invoicing quality, credit notes, collections escalation, bad debt policy).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Consolidation, Intercompany &amp;amp; Group Reporting&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own consolidation processes across entities, ensuring accurate intercompany accounting, reconciliations, eliminations, and multi-currency translation where relevant. You will ensure the quality and timeliness of group reporting inputs and work with FP&amp;amp;A on management reporting, variance explanations, and executive dashboards.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Processes, Risk Management &amp;amp; Scalability&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will design and strengthen accounting processes to support scale\u2014covering close, revenue, treasury, intercompany, and compliance. You will identify accounting, tax, and treasury risks early and implement mitigation plans. You will help shape the roadmap for accounting tooling\/automation (ERP, close management, billing integrations), balancing pragmatism with long-term scalability.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Team Management &amp;amp; Talent Development&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will lead, coach, and grow the accounting team, setting clear expectations and building a culture of rigor, ownership, and continuous improvement. You will define what should be handled in-house versus with external providers, and you will ensure the operating model is fit for global growth&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Compliance and Taxes Support&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate with CPA teams and external advisors to ensure timely compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Prepare and support Local and international tax filings&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assist with transfer pricing documentation and calculation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;\ud83d\udc64 &lt;strong&gt;It would be great if you have:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;10\u201312 years of progressive accounting experience, including leadership experience in a multi-entity environment (ideally SaaS\/technology).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong technical accounting background with demonstrated ability to own complex judgments (revenue recognition, commissions\/costs, consolidation, intercompany, FX).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven track record of leading external audits and strengthening audit readiness and controls.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on understanding of consolidation processes (monthly\/annually), intercompany eliminations, and group reporting cadence.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong systems orientation; experience driving accounting process\/tool improvements (ERP and adjacent finance tooling).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;International \/ Communication Requirements&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluent professional English (written and spoken)\u2014used daily with US and Singapore stakeholders, auditors, and advisors.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to communicate accounting topics clearly to senior non-finance stakeholders and to influence decision-making across time zones and cultures.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Leadership&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven people leadership skills (coaching, performance management, team scaling).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong executive presence, structured approach, and ability to set standards and hold teams accountable.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What\u2019s in it for you?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong class=&quot;s-font-semibold s-text-foreground dark:s-text-foreground-night&quot;&gt;Flex Life:&lt;\/strong&gt; We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join our collaborative and impact-driven Data &amp;amp; Analytics team. You will act as a senior strategic partner to the business, bridging the gap between deep technical modeling and business strategy to power how Dashlane makes decisions.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be a key driver in transforming our team from a reactive support function into a proactive, strategic powerhouse. Your work will directly shape how Dashlane measures success, from building out robust, AI-ready data foundations to delivering actionable insights that directly impact our bottom line. You will tackle complex data architecture problems, empower the organisation through self-service, and act as a force multiplier by mentoring peers and upskilling stakeholders.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you are passionate about treating data as a product, succeed in autonomy, and want to have a massive, visible impact on a thriving B2B\/B2C SaaS business, this role is for you.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location-Specific Information:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be based in Paris, with English as your working language. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work.&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;At Dashlane, you will:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build &amp;amp; own complex data models: Design, build, test, and own end-to-end data models within our dbt-powered \u201cUnified Data Model\u201d. You will untangle historically messy datasets (like Salesforce) and refactor them into clean, intuitive models that serve as a single source of truth.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive proactive business impact: Act as a consultative partner to our Product + Go-to-Market and business teams. You're systematic: you'd rather improve the system than re-fix the same symptom. You're satisfied shipping the 80% solution at 20% of the effort, then iterating on it. That is the job.<br \/><br \/><\/p><h1>Why this role exists<\/h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is the first dedicated data hire in years. The foundations run, the steering is up to you.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">While BigQuery already houses most of our data, we still lack key Growth data and a cohesive data governance framework. We need unified definitions, a canonical schema, and a robust semantic layer, enabling Growth, Finance, Ops and Product to self-serve insights efficiently and reliably.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Today the stack holds because individuals across Ops, Growth, Finance and Engineering compensate locally. They learned the quirks and built workarounds. It works, but it is fragile: KPIs drift between tools, tracking breaks silently, costs escalate, and nobody owns the translation between raw engineering data and decision-ready truth.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You will be the single accountable owner of that layer. Not a support function, not a ticketing desk, not a BI factory.<br \/><br \/><\/p><h1>What you will own<\/h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Canonical models and metric definitions.<\/strong> A documented semantic layer with canonical entities (Buyer, Seller, Asset, Agent) and Bronze \/ Silver \/ Gold layers. Clear contracts between what Engineering exposes and what each function consumes, so that KPI debates are aligned on the same metric.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Self-serve enablement.<\/strong> The submerged part of the iceberg: clean models, consistent BI primitives, row- and column-level security, so Ops, Growth, Finance and Account Managers build their own dashboards without compromising on accuracy.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Analytics and tracking governance.<\/strong> The global event taxonomy and tracking roadmap, a hybrid client-side and server-side event strategy, consistent sync across CRMs and marketing platforms, and GDPR consent flows by design, so acquisition spend runs on attribution we can trust.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Platform reliability, safety and cost.<\/strong> Standards set once rather than team by team: tested and versioned transformations, monitoring of freshness, failures and usage, sane ingestion patterns (read replicas, CDC, batch), and no production code path depending on BI tables.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Data and AI driving decisions.<\/strong> Our internal AI tooling already queries the data warehouse for analyses. What\u2019s missing is the core foundation: standardized metric definitions, reusable logic, and pre-computed data models.<br \/><br \/><\/p><h1>What success looks like after 12 months<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">One documented event taxonomy, actually used by Engineering, Growth and CRM.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">One semantic layer where every shared KPI has a single definition, a single owner and a version history. New joiners understand the data model in days, not months.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Published freshness and failure SLAs, an explicit ingestion topology, and no production path depending on BI tables.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Ops, Growth, Finance and AMs build most of their recurring dashboards themselves, and AI agents query the data layer safely through curated MCPs.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Growth attribution is trustworthy enough that annual acquisition spend decisions are defensible end to end.<br \/><br \/><\/p><\/li><\/ul><h1>What we are looking for<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">7+ years as a Data, Analytics or Platform Engineer, ideally including a stint at a fast-moving consumer or marketplace company. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks \u2013 keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company\u2019s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Account Executive is responsible for achieving quota by selling solutions into a defined account list that may include current Commvault customers and high value prospects.&amp;nbsp; The position is a field sales role where the AE will engage in face-to-face sales with customers and prospects either directly or through partners. The Account Executive plans, organizes, leads and controls balanced sales growth, account penetration and customer satisfaction on a long-term multi-quarter basis. This individual may lead a cross-functional sales team and is responsible for creating sales campaigns to penetrate\/expand his\/her target accounts. The AE must have the ability to articulate an in-depth understanding of the customers\u2019 environment, current challenges\/goals and have the ability to align Commvault solutions to those challenges\/goals including a financial and strategic value proposition.&amp;nbsp; The candidate must have a history of success in selling complex software platforms (vs. IT component or narrow focused tools) and should have some level of prior engagement with the target account set.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How you will make an impact:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Achieve quarterly and annual quotas by selling to new and established - large, complex prospects and customer.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and implement Strategic account plans for target account expansion and new account acquisition including performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Create sale campaigns into target accounts and closely coordinate company executive involvement with customer\/prospect leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coordinate the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet account performance objectives and customers\u2019 expectations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage a matrixed sales team; liaison with clients, Deal Desk, inside sales, partners, channels, sales engineers, professional services, finance and legal to drive a prospect to close&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establish and maintain a productive, professional relationship with key personnel in assigned customer\/prospect accounts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Construct and deliver tangible business cases at the CXO level including financial (ROI &amp;amp; TCO), technical and strategic value propositions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Prepare and present sales proposals and presentations to new and existing clients&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify and build strategic relationships with partners and alliances that have existing relationships with the assigned target accounts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Negotiate and close deals following the company\u2019s practices and processes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure orders meet all legal and financial requirements&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain a high level of relevant industry, Commvault and competitive knowledge&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Plan, attend and coordinate executive briefings&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Leverage internal sales tools and processes to drive opportunities to a successful close.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Position Requirements include:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in identifying, building relationships and selling directly or with partners&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communication skills, persuasive, listening skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Background in IT infrastructure, security and SAAS&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience of MEDDICC sales methodology or similar would be an advantage&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluent German language skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience selling software solutions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;#LI-EL1&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;#LI-remote&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;jd-info au-target&quot; Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems. They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;p&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;6gic8&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;9j17i-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;9j17i-0-0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;9j17i-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;9j17i-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security&#39;s product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once. You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle. You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship. At Overstory, we\u2019re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;That\u2019s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we\u2019re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We\u2019re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Join us to help us build a more resilient world together.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;Role &amp;amp; Team&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a &lt;strong&gt;Staff Data Engineer&lt;\/strong&gt; at Overstory, you will lead the design and scaling of the data platform that enables Overstory\u2019s AI-powered vegetation analysis. Our analysis depends on moving enormous volumes of satellite imagery, model inferences, and utility network data through orchestrated pipelines reliably, repeatably, and on time to support customer decision-making. You&#39;ll own the architecture of that platform and set the direction for how it evolves.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll work closely with data, ML, and product engineers, as well as product teams, to make sure the data flowing into our models and out to our customers balances pragmatic delivery with durability, traceability, and scalability. As a senior technical leader, you&#39;ll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and set standards for pipeline design, service boundaries, and data quality across Overstory.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Time zone requirement: &lt;\/strong&gt;Europe (GMT\/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In collaboration with data, ML, and product colleagues, you will:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Architect and evolve our orchestration layer \u2014 asset graphs, quality checks, partitioning strategies, and the patterns that keep it scaling reliably.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and maintain production data pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead system design work across the data platform, including service boundaries, data contracts, and designing around the failure modes that come with each.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive the shift toward a service-oriented architecture, decoupling tightly bound components into services that teams can own and deploy independently.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build event-driven workflows, replacing brittle coupling and manual coordination with durable messaging patterns.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establish observability, testing, and data quality frameworks so problems surface before customers see them, allowing any result to be traced back and explained.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mentor engineers and define the standards for how we build, test, and operate data systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Skills &amp;amp; Experience&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience thriving at the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale scientific data; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk and improve grid resilience through better data patterns and infrastructure&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep hands-on experience with &lt;strong&gt;Dagster&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 asset-based orchestration, partitions, sensors, and the operational side of running it in production (comparable experience with Airflow, Prefect, or similar is a reasonable substitute if you&#39;re ready to go deep on Dagster)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven track record building and operating &lt;strong&gt;data pipelines&lt;\/strong&gt; at scale, with a real feel for idempotency, backfills, and partitioning&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in preparing systems to handle periods of high demand with a focus on testability and scalability best practices&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong &lt;strong&gt;system design&lt;\/strong&gt; skills \u2014 you can reason about boundaries, contracts, coupling, and failure modes, and explain the tradeoffs to people who&#39;ll use and build on them&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical experience designing &lt;strong&gt;service-oriented architecture&lt;\/strong&gt;, including versioning and keeping things operational through migrations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong &lt;strong&gt;Python&lt;\/strong&gt; skills and experience with &lt;strong&gt;Google Cloud&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with &lt;strong&gt;Pub\/Sub&lt;\/strong&gt; and event-driven patterns&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, ML, and product&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in remote-first and globally distributed team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Nice To Have&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfort working with geospatial data and the ways that it\u2019s stored&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building data pipelines that power ML training and inference&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with analytics engineering tooling and warehouse modeling in BigQuery&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Infrastructure-as-code experience and comfort owning your systems in production&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Background in remote sensing, forestry, or the utility sector&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Note:&lt;\/strong&gt; We believe that all people are capable of great things. This includes oversight of HTA submissions, value dossiers, and real-world evidence studies across multiple international markets. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in health economics and outcomes research across several international markets and experience supporting the introduction of innovative therapies in a global biotech environment. You are eager to make a meaningful contribution in pre-launch and launch phases, particularly within rare diseases and orphan conditions, and bring strong communication skills, adaptability, and the At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation\u2014including the ethical &amp;amp; thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;134233117&amp;quot;:true,&amp;quot;134233118&amp;quot;:true,&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About BridgeBio&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;BridgeBio is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing, and delivering transformative medicines for patients living with genetic diseases and genetically defined cancers. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a diverse portfolio of more than 20 drug development programs, ranging from early discovery to late-stage clinical trials, across multiple therapeutic areas including precision oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, neurology, and renal disease. We have already achieved regulatory approval for three therapies and continue to advance promising science from academia into meaningful treatments for patients worldwide.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who We Are&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;BridgeBio is a global biotechnology company with our Global Headquarters located in San Francisco, USA, and our International HQ located in Zug, Switzerland. Since establishing our European presence in 2021, we\u2019ve been building empowered, high-performing teams across countries \u2014 experienced colleagues who move quickly, take ownership, and are fueling the company\u2019s international growth.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At BridgeBio, you\u2019ll find an energetic and collaborative culture where pragmatism meets bold decision-making. We embrace uncertainty with confidence, guided by our commitment to making a meaningful impact for patients. Our people are trusted and empowered, united by urgency, purpose, and the drive to advance science for patients around the world.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Director, Patient Advocacy, for Hypoparathyroidism leads the development and execution of Calcilytix\u2019s patient advocacy strategy in support of clinical development and commercialization, while safeguarding long-term patient trust and community relationships.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Patient Advocacy for Calcilytix, this role drives engagement across the International Hypoparathyroidism community, ensuring community insights inform company strategy and decision-making.&amp;nbsp; The Director oversees external international partnerships and educational initiatives, strengthening meaningful outreach across the region.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a strategic cross-functional partner, this leader collaborates with clinical development, medical affairs, commercial, and market access teams to integrate authentic patient perspectives into planning and execution.&amp;nbsp; The role also champions a patient-focused culture within the international organization by elevating international community insights and ensuring regional perspectives inform strategy.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Resposanbilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and execute a comprehensive international patient advocacy and engagement strategy aligned with the Calcilytix hypoparathyroidism portfolio, ensuring patient and community insights meaningfully inform clinical development and commercialization planning.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the primary liaison to international advocacy organizations, establishing and strengthening compliant, long-term relationships built on trust, transparency, and alignment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Integrate the patient voice across the product lifecycle, determining the appropriate timing and approach for engagement activities (e.g., advisory boards, patient organization summits, surveys, protocol input, patient-facing materials, community initiatives) in alignment with key development milestones.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Translate community insights into actionable guidance for cross-functional partners, including clinical development, medical affairs, regulatory, and commercial teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support launch readiness and post-marketing activities, ensuring patient needs, access considerations, and real-world experiences meaningfully inform planning and execution.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead strategic planning and oversight of advocacy-related budgets, including grants, sponsorships, advisory engagements, and educational initiatives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Champion a patient-centered culture across the international organization by embedding the voice of international patients and caregivers into internal communications, programming, and regional initiatives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain expertise in relevant healthcare policy and industry regulations governing patient advocacy engagement and ensure compliant execution of all external activities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrate strong executive presence and leadership, serving as a trusted advisor internally and externally while representing Calcilytix within the hypoparathyroidism community.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The above job description documents the general nature and level of work but is not intended to be an exhaustive list of activities, duties, and responsibilities required of job incumbents. Therefore, job incumbents are expected to perform all other duties as assigned or required, as training and experience allow.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Where You\u2019ll Work&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is an office-based role and requires in-office collaboration 2-3x per week in our Zug Office. The role requires up to 30% travel across Europe and internationally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who You Are&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor\u2019s degree required; advanced degree preferred.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;8+ years of patient advocacy or community engagement experience, including 3+ years within biotech\/pharma.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working with rare disease communities in Europe; endocrinology experience preferred.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong understanding of the European healthcare landscape, including EMA processes, country-specific access considerations, and relevant policy frameworks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships with international patient organizations while balancing business priorities and maintaining credibility.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience managing complex or sensitive advocacy situations with sound judgment and compliance expertise.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Executive presence with strong cross-functional leadership and collaboration.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;High professionalism, discretion, and ability to work independently within a matrixed organization.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;No matter your role at BridgeBio, successful team members are:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Patient Champions who put patients first and uphold strict ethical standards&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Entrepreneurial Operators who drive toward practical solutions and have an ownership mindset&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Truth Seekers, who are detailed, rational, and humble problem solvers&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Individuals Who Inspire Excellence in themselves and those around them&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;High-quality executors who execute against goals and milestones with quality, precision, and speed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.&amp;nbsp;
